profile_notes: Travel bodies — the compact, capable all-rounder you carry all day and trust in varied conditions. GATE: require:[] — travel is about balance, not a single spec threshold, so a hard gate would be arbitrary; fit is expressed through axis weights. CRUX at 3: handling — size / weight / portability / all-day carry comfort is the single most-cited travel-body priority (a travel camera you leave in the hotel is worthless). SECONDARY at 2: image_quality (it still has to deliver the shots the trip was for — travel buyers refuse to trade away quality for size) and battery_life (long days sightseeing away from a charger). SUPPORTING at 1: sensor_performance (mixed light from bright plazas to dim interiors and night markets), stabilization (handheld low-light travel without a tripod), build (weather/dust resistance for the road). Deliberately UNWEIGHTED (0/omitted): autofocus_body, af_performance, burst_buffer (travel is generalist, not action-specialised), video_capability, connectivity, evf_lcd, color_rendition — real but not the axes that separate a travel-capable body. gear_class excludes novelty only. DISTINCT-FINGERPRINT CHECK: shares handling 3 with the street profile but differs by weighting battery_life + image_quality as the all-day all-rounder secondaries (street leads its secondaries with autofocus_body for candid capture); this is the generalist body guide, deliberately AF-agnostic.
